run_rocm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits: run FP8 MQA logits computation using paged KV-cache for ROCm with aiter or torch fallback
run_rocm_fp8_mqa_logits: run FP8 MQA logits computation for a single sequence without KV paging on ROCm
run_rocm_aiter_sparse_attn_indexer: run ROCm aiter sparse attention indexer to compute top-k token indices from KV cache

build_cp_gather_indexer_k_quant_cache_tr: build triton kernel to gather quantized K and scale values from paged KV-cache into contiguous tensors
